requirement.description: The sync module is completely missing from the pypeln package. Tests are attempting to access pl.sync.map, pl.sync.from_iterable, pl.sync.get_namespace, etc. but these functions don't exist because the sync module isn't implemented.
requirement.contract: Create a sync module that mirrors the interface of thread/process/task modules but operates synchronously. It should provide: - Functions: map, filter, flat_map, concat, from_iterable, each, run, to_iterable - Utility function: get_namespace - All functions should behave synchronously and follow the same API contract as the thread/process/task modules - Should be importable as pl.sync
requirement.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_sync.py should pass, specifically: - test_from_to_iterable - test_map_id - test_flat_map_square - test_concat_basic - test_error_handling - test_worker_info - test_kwargs - test_map_square_event_start - test_map_square_event_end - test_map_square_workers - test_flat_map_square_workers - test_flat_map_square_filter_workers - test_flat_map_square_filter_workers_pipe - test_from_to_iterable_simple - test_from_to_iterable_pipe - test_map_id_pipe - test_map_square - test_map_square_workers - test_concat_multiple - test_from_to_iterable
